notes.title: Steam Achievements Update
notes.notes:
Like the previous announcement stated all in game achievements are now converted to Steam achievements. In this update there are also some minor bug fixes and the game should now run fine in FullHD even on old laptops with bad display adapters. Please let us know if you notice any bugs in this version, thanks!

Mick @ Gamephase

notes.title: Steam Achievements
notes.notes: All achievements in the game are now converted to Steam achievements, the game is not yet updated so the achievements will not be unlocked until then. Any previously unlocked achievements in the game will be converted into unlocked Steam achievements! The update will be available 14-15 of December 2015.
